page.layout: One scanned image showing a closed book lying on a dark background, seen from the fore-edge and front cover in perspective. No printed page is legible; the cover is blank parchment-coloured board with stains and four thongs/tie marks along the right edge. No text blocks, no margins with text.
page.notes: The scan shows the book's boards and page edges, not a printed page. There is no printed text, page number, running head, catchword or signature to transcribe. Stains, green spots and brown marks on the cover are discolouration, not writing. Nothing was transcribed.
